goal: Goal 17 offline product studio lighting rig

renderer.fallback: KeyShot or SOLIDWORKS Visualize can use the same material split and light intent.
renderer.localAvailability: Blender, KeyShot, and SOLIDWORKS were not found in PATH or common install folders during this run.

renderSettings.outputFormat: PNG for review, EXR or 16-bit PNG recommended for final grading

stage.background: matte white / very light warm grey
stage.floor: shadow catcher only, not a visible white plane cutting through the model
stage.blackCards: two non-rendering black reflection cards outside camera view to create dark metal bands
stage.scaleRule: model is centered from imported GLB bounds; no source asset is overwritten

lights.purpose: large soft catalogue highlight across body and flanges
narrow strip highlight on machined stem, flange rims, and round edges
separate right flange and drive silhouette from white background
keep lower fasteners readable without flattening black levels

cameraSetups.purpose: replace the flat all-silver WebGL read with a material-layered catalogue product still
validate the ordered anatomy with realistic metal contrast and no fogged white plane
validate polished ball, fixed soft-seat rings, dark cavities, and drive-stack highlights

acceptance: No visible white clipping plane or fog band crosses the product.
At least five material families are readable at first glance: shell, machined cuts, polished ball, dark fasteners/cavities, and soft-seat rings.
The render contains controlled dark reflection bands; stainless does not become a uniform light grey shader.
The true ball core can rotate 90 degrees while seats remain fixed.
The stills are generated by an offline renderer before they are treated as commercial-grade output.
